map.由衰变常数求半衰期。: Find the half-life from the decay constant.
map.与衰变常数互为倒数关系。: It is the reciprocal style relation with the decay constant.
map.📚 深度解析：由衰变常数求半衰期: 📚 Deep Dive: Half-life from the decay constant
map.已知 λ 求特征时间。: Find the characteristic time from a known λ.
map.若 λ=1.21e-3，则 th≈573 年，寿命缩短十倍。: If λ = 1.21e-3, then th ≈ 573 years, ten times shorter.
map.不是直接倒数，而是 th=ln2/λ，差一个 ln2 系数。: Not directly: th = ln2/λ, so they differ by the factor ln2.
map.λ 用 yr⁻¹ 则 th 为年，用 s⁻¹ 则 th 为秒，须匹配。: A λ in yr⁻¹ gives th in years and a λ in s⁻¹ gives th in seconds, so the units must agree.
map.由衰变常数求半衰期：T½ = ln2 ÷ λ = 0.69314718056 ÷: Half-life from the decay constant: T½ = ln2 ÷ λ = 0.69314718056 ÷ λ (years, λ the decay constant in year⁻¹); linked values: mean lifetime τ = 1 ÷ λ (years), fraction remaining after 1 year = e^(−λ)×100 (%). Validation: required guard for λ, which as a denominator must not be 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; T½ is inversely proportional to λ (the larger λ the faster the decay), and the mean lifetime τ = T½÷ln2 ≈ 1.44×T½.
